Kangana Ranaut Extends Wishes as Omar Abdullah and Nidhi Razdan Announce Marriage

Public Figures Share Wedding Announcement on Social Media

Bollywood actor and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Member of Parliament Kangana Ranaut publicly congratulated Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and television journalist Nidhi Razdan following their recent marriage announcement.

Mr. Abdullah formally shared the news on social media on Saturday, posting four photographs alongside the caption, "A new journey began yesterday..." Ms. Razdan also confirmed the marriage on X, writing, "It's done, bro."

Ceremony Details and Family Attendance

According to reported accounts and social media disclosures:

  • Location and Legal Framework: The ceremony was reportedly solemnised in New Delhi under the Special Marriage Act on Friday.
  • Family Presence: Close family members from both sides attended the wedding functions held in New Delhi and Srinagar.
  • Notable Attendees: National Conference president Farooq Abdullah and Mollie Abdullah, along with Mr. Abdullah's three sisters, were present. Ms. Razdan's parents, veteran journalist MK Razdan and Sarla Razdan, also attended.

Background Context

Unattributed sources and public records indicate that this is the second marriage for both individuals. Mr. Abdullah, 56, was previously married to Payal, with whom the Supreme Court dissolved the marriage following a settlement order in July. Ms. Razdan, 49, is likewise entering her second marriage.

Verification and Next Steps

Readers seeking to verify the details of this announcement can consult official social media handles belonging to Omar Abdullah and Nidhi Razdan, where the initial marriage announcements and photographs were published. Independent confirmation of legal filings or official government statements regarding the ceremony remains subject to further updates from the families or authorized spokespersons.
